description.zh:
是否覆盖现有API。

覆盖检测条件为：API的HTTP请求类型+后端请求路径相同。
description.en:
Specifies whether to overwrite the existing API.

APIs with the same HTTP request type and backend request path are considered the same.

title.zh: 通过 Swagger 创建 API

descriptions.zh:
- 阿里云目前支持基于Swagger 2.0的扩展
- 只支持json/yaml格式的Swagger配置文件
descriptions.en:
- Alibaba Cloud supports extensions based on Swagger 2.0.

- Alibaba Cloud supports Swagger configuration files in JSON and YAML formats.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi import-swagger --overwrite true --data-format yaml --data A_Swagger_API_definition_in_YAML --group-id 0009db9c828549768a200320714b0000 --dry-run true --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi ImportSwagger --region cn-hangzhou --Overwrite true --GlobalCondition '{}' --DataFormat yaml --DryRun true --Data A_Swagger_API_definition_in_YAML --GroupId 0009db9c828549768a200320714b0000
